difficulty_target_scale: expected_learner_difficulty is a reviewed continuous 0.00-1.00 learner-difficulty target. 0.00 is first-Japanese-lesson material; 1.00 is recondite unused material that many native speakers would not know.

labels.rationale: Basic color word; very early, but not literally first-lesson core.
Basic color word in the same early tier as 黒.
Common basic adjective, usually after the earliest survival vocabulary.
Useful common verb, but less early than the most basic movement, perception, and daily-action verbs.

Easy loanword and common enough, but not especially high-priority general vocabulary.
